'''Sesara Sihn''' was a [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the only child of [[Olianne Sihn]], war leader of the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. When Sesara was eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, she contracted a fever and later [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="Backlash" />
